data_description.bridge: Bridges that support the v2 local API, found on your network. Choose "Enter an IP address" if yours isn't listed.

manual.title: Connect to an iZone bridge
manual.description: No bridge was found automatically. Enter the bridge's IP address (a DHCP reservation is recommended).

data_description.host: The bridge's IP address on your network, e.g. 192.168.1.50. Your router lists it; a DHCP reservation keeps it from changing.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach an iZone v2 bridge at that address.

abort.already_configured: This bridge is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the discovered bridge.

init.title: iZone options
init.description: Notifications appear in Home Assistant when the controller says the filter is due a clean, and when a module's firmware changes.

data_description.notifications: Notify when the filter is due a clean and when firmware changes.

zeroed_data.message: The bridge has answered with zeroed data for {seconds} s; the controller may not be talking to it

zone_modes.message: A zone can only be {modes}; heat, cool and dry are set on the AC itself

airflow_range.message: Minimum airflow ({low}%) can't be above maximum ({high}%)

zone_settings_need_zone.message: zone_mode and temperature need a zone

zone_run_by_system.message: {zone} is run by the system itself, so a favourite doesn't set it

zone_open_close_only.message: {zone} has no temperature control, so it can only be open or close

favourite_not_kept.message: Favourite {favourite} didn't keep the change to {changes} (last error: {error})

update_favourite.name: Update favourite
update_favourite.description: Changes what an iZone favourite stores: one zone's mode and temperature, the fan, and/or the AC mode. It's saved on the controller, so the iZone app and wall controller see it too. Nothing changes until the favourite is next run.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: The zone to change, by name (any case) or number (1 is the first zone).

zone_mode.name: Zone mode
zone_mode.description: What the favourite does to the zone. Leave out to keep what it stores; giving only a temperature sets auto.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The zone's temperature in auto, 15-30 °C in 0.5° steps.

fan.name: Fan
fan.description: The fan speed the favourite sets, or unchanged to leave the fan alone.

mode.name: AC mode
mode.description: The AC mode the favourite sets, or unchanged to leave the mode alone.
